page_title: REN 0-2 TOU | Rennes v Toulouse 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Zakaria Aboukhlal is replaced by Rafik Messali (Toulouse).
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
87' Substitution. Miha Zajc (Toulouse) on for Yann Gboho.
87' The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
84' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
82' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
80' Sebastien Tambouret decides to make a substitution. Jota will be replaced by Mohamed Meite (Rennes).
79' The substitution has been made. Hans Hateboer (Rennes) has replaced Lorenz Assignon.
78' 65:35 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
73' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
73' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Toulouse will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
69' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) replacing Gabriel Suazo.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) replaces Joshua King.
68' Jota (Rennes) commits a rough foul. Romain Lissorgue stops the game and makes a call.
65' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
63' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
62' Sebastien Tambouret has decided to substitute Glen Kamara and he is replaced by Azor Matusiwa (Rennes).
62' Substitution. Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) in, Arnaud Kalimuendo out.
60' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Adrien Truffert (Rennes).
58' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
56' This shall not pass! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
55' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
52' Rennes have a goal ruled out for offside!
50' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
48' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Romain Lissorgue had an easy-decision to make.
46' The referee allows time for a substitution. Steve Mandanda will be replaced by Gauthier Gallon (Rennes).
46' The whistle blows and Romain Lissorgue starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45+1' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
42' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jota (Rennes).
41' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Romain Lissorgue ignores the protests.
39' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
39' The ball possession is 66:34.
34' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
31' A dangerous looking corner kick from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is cleared to safety by the defence. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.

30' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Guillaume Restes pulls off an easy save.
29' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.

28' Close! Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
27' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
27' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Toulouse earn a corner.
23' 0 - 2 Goal! Aron Donnum (Toulouse) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Steve Mandanda. He makes it 0:2.
20' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul.
18' A lofted cross from Jota (Rennes) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

17' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Joshua King (Toulouse) takes a short pass from Zakaria Aboukhlal in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.

13' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
11' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
11' The game is interrupted now, Joshua King (Toulouse) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
8' Romain Lissorgue interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aron Donnum (Toulouse).
8' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
7' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
7' Jota (Rennes) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
5' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The linesman raises his flag. Joshua King (Toulouse) is adjudged offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Toulouse will have the kick-off.
Romain Lissorgue will officiate today.
